Third, S&P cut Thames Water to CCC- across its [[F47]] debt load, knocking Class A 2027 Eurobond bids below par-half to [[F101]] ([[F100]] Class A average mid). Fourth, Fitch cut France (A+) to Negative outlook on Friday just as Fitch's October monitor showed European loan defaults jumping [[F61]] to [[F59]] on French LBOs (Cerba, Arxada) and US loan defaults hitting [[F63]], while Fed H.8 bank-to-NDFI loans hit an all-time record [[F106]] ([[F108]] of all US bank loans) and weekend capital markets rationed AI credit across Meta (S&P AA- Negative on [[F78]] CapEx), OpenAI ([[F79]] round cut), Anthropic (expected BB junk rating), and Intel ([[F82]], [[F83]] OEM memory squeeze).
